info.title: FFF Stack CLI — scaffold and enforce DDD structure
info.description: FFF Stack CLI — scaffold and enforce DDD structure

commands.name: Generate
commands.description:
fff generate feature   <Name>   Domain + Workflows + Endpoints
fff generate model     <Name>   Domain type file only
fff generate form      <TypeName>   Form FJSX from domain record
fff generate edit      <TypeName>   Edit FJSX from domain record
fff generate list      <TypeName>   List FJSX from domain record
fff generate page      <Name>   Server FJSX page
fff generate component <Name>   Client component + FJSX
fff generate migration <desc>   SQL migration file

commands.name: Inspect
commands.description:
fff routes                    List all registered HTTP routes
fff check                     Validate DDD layer dependencies
fff context                   Bounded context map + violation check
fff context --mermaid         Output Mermaid graph definition

commands.name: Prototype
commands.description: fff prototype  <Name>   Full vertical slice (no DB, in-memory)
